title: A benign SQLite predecessor change fails queued-prompt fences and can strand a handoff offer
outcome: A same-store write interleaving during transcript preparation cannot permanently strand an otherwise eligible held handoff prompt; exact durable-content acknowledgement and transcript predecessor safety remain intact.
acceptance: Classify the observed predecessor-change/held-offer failure from the preserved Mac gate and identify the competing write path without attributing unrelated historical OS35 failures.

Resolve the preparation-conflict liveness failure through the existing persistence/fence/queue owners while preserving exact-content acknowledgement, supersession, Stop/Cancel and predecessor safety; no uncommitted prompt is delivered.

Validate the minimal correction using the repository's standard review pair and relevant maintained checks, with deterministic discrimination of the conflicting-writer interleaving rather than deadline inflation or blind retry.
